name: semester-hq-tests
description: Dev tooling for the tests in this folder: the browser suite (e2e/) and the security rules suite (rules/). Kept out of the repo root so the app itself stays a no-build-step static site; nothing installed here ships to a student. The node tests next to this file (run.mjs, worker-*.mjs, smoke.mjs) need none of it.

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: node with-emulators.mjs firestore,storage -- node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules/firestore.test.mjs rules/storage.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node with-emulators.mjs auth,firestore,storage -- npx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:headed: node with-emulators.mjs auth,firestore,storage -- npx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.mjs --headed
